scope.summary: Implement the get_garment MCP tool (canonical per Master Spec 13.13.4; supersedes the non-canonical fetch_simulation_receipt working name): read the current GarmentSpec and the latest typed SimulationReceipt for a draft or authority garment by garment id.
acceptance_criteria: Tool is registered under the canonical MCP wire name get_garment (13.13.4); no fetch_simulation_receipt tool name is exposed.
Returns the current GarmentSpec (draft or authority) plus the latest typed SimulationReceipt (converged, residual, collision/validation summary, suggested_fix hints) when one exists.
SimulationReceipt delivery via simulate_garment/promote_garment return values remains the primary receipt path; get_garment is the read-back path for resumed or observing agents.
scope.risk_if_missed: Without get_garment, resumed or parallel swarm agents cannot read current garment state and last receipt; a non-canonical receipt-fetch tool name drifts from spec 13.13.4's exact six-tool surface.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
